question: In Linear: Set the priority to Urgent on the Web team's issue in the Website Redesign project that's marked Done, was completed on August 14, and whose description mentions the pagination fix. If there isn't one, just tell me.
final:
Checked the Website Redesign project in Linear — there's no matching issue. Here's what I found:

- **WEB-5** "Update checkout header styling" — the only Web team issue in the project. It's in **Todo** (not Done), has no completion date, and its description is just "Minor styling tweaks; no functional change." No mention of pagination.
- The issue that actually matches three of the four criteria is **MOB-1** "Polish checkout confirmation screen" — it's in the Website Redesign project, marked completed (Shipped), completed **Aug 14**, and the description does mention "the pagination fix"… but it belongs to the **Mobile** team, not Web.

So no change was made. If you meant MOB-1 (the pagination-fix issue from Aug 14), say the word and I'll set its priority to Urgent.
